evidence: Shopify Excel Ledger intelligence platform with dark aesthetic, multi-sheet workbook analysis, 7 departmental dashboards, and live comparative benchmarking.
100% client-side computation. Workbooks are parsed in-memory, cached in browser IndexedDB, and never transmitted over the network.
Modern e-commerce ledgers generated by Shopify exports often contain irregular schemas, composite product bundles, inconsistent date serials, and fragmented departmental requirements.
